# TestScript for 30-config-loader — the environment tier outranks the document.
# DEPLOY_HOST binds with environment provenance even though the document set
# host for the dev profile.

# 1. The environment variable outranks the document value.
env DEPLOY_HOST=env.example.com
exec deploy
stdout '--host\s+string\s+env\.example\.com\s+● env DEPLOY_HOST'
stdout 'connect env\.example\.com:7100 headers=1 force-all=false'

# 2. Command-line flags still outrank the environment.
exec deploy --host cli.example.com
stdout '--host\s+string\s+cli\.example\.com\s+● cli --host'
